source_observation: Derived from Phase 2 corpus analysis; observed practice, not universal legal requirements.

logical_blocks.observation: Case/mool-vad number and year commonly follow the court heading.
Party names and a recurring “बनाम” separator are strongly recurrent.
Recurring opening construction for the plaintiff statement is observed.
Long factual paragraphs are commonly numbered; numeric + parenthesized Hindi words occur in source text.
Some pleadings contain jurisdiction/cause-of-action style paragraphs; presence varies.
Observed in some plaints; conditional rather than universal.
Verification is detected in 91/94; many Dava files also contain affidavit material.
Advocate/date/signature blocks recur near the end.

generation_rules: Treat Dava files as potentially multi-component packages; do not assume the first prayer or affidavit is the end.
conditionality: Do not fabricate missing facts; select blocks by matter and subtype.
